# Upstream notice sources

Retrieved for the locked dependency versions on 2026-10-28. Line endings and trailing whitespace are normalised; wording and license terms are retained.

- `onnxruntime-LICENSE.txt`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/v1.31.1/LICENSE
- `onnxruntime-ThirdPartyNotices.txt`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/v1.31.1/ThirdPartyNotices.txt
- `react-three-fiber-LICENSE.txt`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pmndrs/react-three-fiber/v9.8.2/LICENSE
- `../CC-BY-4.0.txt`: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode.txt

Other notices are read from the installed, lockfile-pinned npm package contents. `guid-typescript@1.0.9` declares ISC in package.json but ships no separate license file, and its upstream repository has no license endpoint. The generated notice retains its published declaration and author metadata without inventing a copyright notice. Its npm gitHead is `1870de806c3db7ba46c5b8a1387c60fc9dda9284` in https://github.com/NicolasDeveloper/guid-typescript.
